name: MONUSCO
detail: UN peacekeeping mission; mandate extended to Dec 20, 2026 by Resolution 2808, with operations now focused on North Kivu and Ituri as a conditions-based drawdown is prepared.

name: SAMIDRC (Withdrawn)
detail: SADC's South Africa-Tanzania-Malawi mission lost troops in the fall of Goma; its mandate was terminated Mar 13, 2025 and its phased withdrawal through Rwanda ran from Apr 29 to mid-2025.

name: FARDC
detail: Congolese national army, repeatedly routed in 2025 urban battles for Goma, Bukavu and Uvira; rebuilding around joint operations with Wazalendo militias in the 2026 Masisi counteroffensive.

name: Wazalendo Militias
detail: Pro-government self-defense militia coalition fighting alongside FARDC against M23; led village recaptures in the Feb 2026 Masisi offensive and continued clashes near Kavumu in Aug 2026.

name: Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF)
detail: Ugandan forces operating jointly with FARDC in Operation Shujaa against ADF/ISCAP in Ituri and North Kivu since 2021.

name: FDLR
detail: Rwandan Hutu militia whose disarmament is a core DRC obligation under the Washington Accords; a faction signed a DDR protocol Jul 28, 2025, which Rwanda rejected as insufficient in 2026.

name: AFC/M23
detail: Alliance Fleuve Congo coalition led by Corneille Nangaa, with M23 as its military wing under Bertrand Bisimwa; controls Goma, Bukavu, Uvira and the Rubaya mine as of Aug 2026.

name: ADF / ISCAP
detail: Islamic State Central Africa Province, the Allied Democratic Forces' Islamic State-aligned faction, active against civilians in Ituri and North Kivu; pledged bay'ah to IS in 2019.

name: Washington Accords Joint Oversight Committee
detail: DRC, Rwanda, the AU Facilitator (Togo), Qatar and the US body overseeing accord implementation; met in Paris Jul 24, 2026. Its Joint Security Coordination Mechanism (JSCM) convened at the US Mission in Geneva Aug 12-13, 2026, where DRC and Rwanda agreed to advance two monitoring/verification initiatives and DRC presented its FDLR DDR plan; the next JSCM session is scheduled for Sept 16-17, 2026 in Geneva, ahead of an October trilateral planning conference to produce a revised Operations Order.

name: MONUSCO Drawdown Review
detail: Security Council-mandated process under Resolution 2808 to plan a gradual, conditions-based MONUSCO exit while preserving protection of civilians in North Kivu and Ituri.

name: Twirwaneho / Red-Tabara
detail: Banyamulenge self-defense militia allied with M23/AFC in the South Kivu highlands; clashed with pro-government forces around Minembwe, Nyaruhinga and Mukoko in Aug 2026 and was linked by FARDC to drone strikes near Fizi.

name: Vectus Global (Erik Prince-linked PMC)
detail: Private military contractor founded by Blackwater's Erik Prince, reportedly under a roughly $700M DRC government contract centered on mineral-revenue security in Katanga; Reuters reported the firm has also deployed personnel to operate drones and support FARDC-coalition forces defending Uvira and the South Kivu highlands (including around Fizi and Minembwe) against RDF/M23-Twirwaneho forces.
